props.claim: Only an admin can create preceptor accounts.
Accepting an email invitation creates and links a new Abhyasi account, or links an existing account to the additional preceptor without recreating it.
An Abhyasi may be linked to multiple preceptors and see slots from all of them.
Slot dates and AM/PM start times are entered in the preceptor's own timezone; times are stored in UTC.
Slot duration defaults to 45 minutes and is changeable per slot.
Slot capacity defaults to 1 and may exceed 1 for group sittings.
Visibility defaults to all linked Abhyasis, or can be restricted to specifically chosen Abhyasis.
The preceptor can copy the previous week's plan into the current week.
Publishing sends one batched email per eligible Abhyasi listing all newly visible slots, while a single slot added later sends its own announcement.
A pre-booked Abhyasi receives the normal booking email and can cancel the booking like any other.
Only open slots visible to the Abhyasi across all linked preceptors are shown, in the Abhyasi's own timezone.
Booking is instant without preceptor approval.
Concurrent attempts cannot book a slot beyond its capacity.
Cancellation has no cutoff; a freed spot silently reopens for others with no announcement email blast.
The reminder offers one-click 'Cancel my booking' without logging in.
On cancelling a booking, the preceptor chooses to keep the slot open for others or delete it entirely.
Deleting a slot cancels every booking on it.
Cancellation emails are sent subject to email settings.
The Abhyasi gets a reminder before the sitting at the preceptor-set lead time (default 8 hours); the preceptor gets no reminder.
The reminder includes one-click 'I'm coming' and 'Cancel my booking' actions that do not require logging in.
The dashboard displays each booking as confirmed, cancelled, or no reply.

The four independently configurable email types are new-slots announcement, booking confirmed, booking cancelled, and reminder; booking confirmations go to both parties, cancellations to affected parties, and reminders only to Abhyasis.
There is no master switch; preceptors control separate sent and personally received lists while Abhyasis control received types.
Delivery requires both the preceptor's send gate and the recipient's receive setting for that type.
All email toggles default to ON.
The preceptor sets reminder lead time in hours, defaulting to 8.
